title: pilosella flagellaris subsp. subsarmentosa
intro: Pilosella flagellaris subsp. subsarmentosa, commonly known as a type of sanguisorba, is a plant species used in traditional medicine. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella flagellaris subsp. subsarmentosa include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial actions, which may be beneficial in wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may help in protecting against oxidative stress and cell damage.
